data.reason: Frozen v1 E1–E6 first-pass assessment. Publisher original article abstract explicitly describes two human-participant driving-simulator experiments comparing text-to-speech, spearcons and auditory icons across background-noise conditions, with warning recognition accuracy and reaction-time outcomes. E1–E6 appear satisfied at title/abstract stage; include solely to seek and verify complete original full text. The primary publisher Abstract was directly verified; additional selected body passages appeared in a search-index rendering but the publisher /doi/full route returned 403 on direct fetch, so those passages are discovery-only, not qualified original full-text access; no complete Experiment 1 or Experiment 2 review, participant-overlap adjudication, audio playback, numeric extraction, raw document custody or hashed manifestation occurred. Two reported experiments are not two independently admitted samples.
data.access_limitation: Original publisher https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/0018720819879311; DOI 10.1177/0018720819879311; journal edition Human Factors 63(2), 312–335 (March 2021), first published online 2019-10-08. Read on 2026-11-10: publisher Abstract (Objective through Application) verified on original /doi/abs page. Search index additionally rendered body-looking passages labelled Current Study, Experiment 1 > Method > Participants and General Discussion, but a direct /doi/full/10.1177/0018720819879311 fetch returned 403; these unverified secondary renderings do not prove original article access, complete Methods or authorized original full-text use. Publisher HTTP Date and original HTML/PDF bytes/hash were not captured, reproduction rights not inferred. Existing Crossref verified DOI identity SRC-R006-H-SABIC-UNDERSTANDING@1 was metadata_only; no new manifestation or reader AID registered. Publication DOI has one original discovery occurrence HIT-R005R-C1RECOVERY-EQ1-00046. No human verification, audiovisual inspection, study or participant sample admitted. Potential first-author thesis duplication remains unresolved.
